title: Cultural Alignment in Large Language Models Using Soft Prompt Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2503.16094v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment is commonly achieved through supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, both of which require labeled or preference data and update model weights. Without targeted cultural adaptation, however, deployed LLMs often exhibit culturally homogeneous behavior that fails to reflect diverse local values. Aligning models to cultural value frameworks such as Hofstede's Value Survey Module (VSM13) presents a distinct challenge: alignment signals are available only as aggregated survey-level scores computed after generating responses to an entire survey, providing no per-token gradient and requiring no preference data by construction. This makes standard gradient-based alignment methods ill-suited to the task. translated_title: 使用软提示微调实现大语言模型的文化对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的对齐通常通过监督微调或强化学习来实现，这两种方法都需要标注数据或偏好数据，并且需要更新模型权重。然而，如果缺乏针对性的文化适配，部署后的LLM往往表现出文化同质化的行为，无法反映多样化的本地价值观。将模型对齐到霍夫斯泰德价值调查模块（VSM13）等文化价值框架是一个独特的挑战：对齐信号仅以汇总的调查级分数形式提供（该分数是在模型对整份问卷生成回答后计算的），既不提供逐token的梯度，按其构造方式也不需要偏好数据。这使得标准的基于梯度的对齐方法难以适用于该任务。我们提出了一种适合部署的方法，将文化行为编码在简短、可调的软提示中，并使用差分进化（DE）算法进行优化，同时保持模型权重冻结，且不需要……
tldr: 该论文提出一种用差分进化算法优化可调软提示的方法，在冻结模型权重、无需偏好数据的情况下，将大语言模型对齐到霍夫斯泰德文化价值框架，实现部署友好的文化适配。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a deployment-friendly method that optimizes tunable soft prompts via Differential Evolution to align LLMs with Hofstede's cultural value frameworks, keeping model weights frozen and requiring no preference data.
